message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME records for `sample.com` via the VirusTotal API, you can query the domain’s related objects filtered by DNS record type.  
The endpoint you’ll use is:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/related_objects?object_type=dns_record&record_type=CNAME
```

Include your API key in the `x-apikey` header.  
The response will contain a list of related objects; each object has an `id` field.  
Below is a **placeholder** example of what the IDs might look like (replace these with the actual IDs from your API response):

```json
[
  "dns_record/abcd1234",
  "dns_record/efgh5678"
]
```

These IDs uniquely identify the CNAME records associated with `sample.com`.
